import ROOT, math
from collections import Counter
COMP=["energy_trkr","energy_ecal","energy_hcal","energy_scal_X","energy_scal_UV",
      "evis_trkr","evis_ecal","evis_hcal","evis_scal_X","evis_scal_UV"]
FILES=[("1A_DATA","/pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/minerva/minerva_large_files/Data/Playlist1A/MasterAnaDev_data_AnaTuple_run00006038_Playlist.root"),
       ("1A_MC","/pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/minerva/minerva_large_files/MC/StandardMC/Playlist1A/MasterAnaDev_mc_AnaTuple_run00110000_Playlist.root")]
def st(E):
    if E==-9999.0: return "A"      # absent sentinel
    if E==0.0:     return "Z"      # zero-energy third state
    if E>1e-5:     return "P"      # present
    return "?"
for label,p in FILES:
    f=ROOT.TFile.Open(p,"READ"); t=f.Get("MasterAnaDev")
    t.SetBranchStatus("*",0)
    for g in (1,2):
        for s in ["E","P","time","dEdx","direction"]+COMP: t.SetBranchStatus("gamma%d_%s"%(g,s),1)
    N=min(20000,int(t.GetEntries()))
    joint=Counter(); gate=Counter(); zprofile=Counter(); znorm=[]
    for i in range(N):
        t.GetEntry(i)
        s1=st(float(t.gamma1_E)); s2=st(float(t.gamma2_E))
        joint[s1+s2]+=1
        gate[(s1=="P")+(s2=="P")]+=1
        for g,s in ((1,s1),(2,s2)):
            if s!="Z": continue
            comps=[float(getattr(t,"gamma%d_%s"%(g,c))) for c in COMP]
            zprofile["all_10_components_zero" if all(c==0.0 for c in comps) else "some_component_nonzero"]+=1
            zprofile["energy4_sum_zero" if sum(comps[:5])==0.0 else "energy4_sum_nonzero"]+=1
            zprofile["time_is_-9999" if float(getattr(t,"gamma%d_time"%g))==-9999.0 else "time_FILLED"]+=1
            zprofile["dEdx_is_-999" if float(getattr(t,"gamma%d_dEdx"%g))==-999.0 else "dEdx_other"]+=1
            zprofile["P_is_zero" if float(getattr(t,"gamma%d_P"%g))==0.0 else "P_nonzero"]+=1
            d=[float(getattr(t,"gamma%d_direction"%g)[k]) for k in range(3)]
            znorm.append(math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in d)))
    print("#####",label,"entries",N)
    print("  joint (slot1,slot2) states  A=absent Z=zeroE P=present:",dict(joint))
    print("  gate-passing photon count (E>1e-5):",dict(gate))
    print("    -> count==1 events:",gate.get(1,0),"= %.3f%% of entries"%(100*gate.get(1,0)/N))
    print("  zero-E slot profile:",dict(zprofile))
    if znorm: print("  zero-E slot direction norm: n=%d min=%.12f max=%.12f"%(len(znorm),min(znorm),max(znorm)))
    f.Close()
PY
